items.context: Did you have cash ready for the payment
items.text: haan ji

items.context: Can you pay the cash on delivery now
items.text: filhaal nahi

items.context: Can you wait for a while till the payment is resolved
items.text: thoda wait karo
mera cod payment accept nahi hua
delivery guy ne paise nahi leye order ka
main cash ready rakha tha lekin le nahi paya
cod ka pay option kaise enable karun dobara
mera order tk12345678 ka payment issue ho gaya hai
delivery date par main ghar par nahi tha toh payment nahi hua
kya aap mera payment dobara try kar sakte ho

items.context: Can you please tell why you are unable to pay the cash on delivery
items.text: main cash ready rakhta hu par delivery time problem aati hai

items.context: Did the delivery person refuse to take your payment
items.text: maine 1500 rupees ready rakhe the magar delivery person ne le liya nahi

items.context: Did you receive any payment notification during delivery
items.text: mere phone pe payment ka notification nahi aaya tha jab delivery hui

items.context: Are you open to use alternative payment method if cod fails
items.text: kya koi aur payment method use kar sakta hu agar cod fail ho jaye

items.context: Was there any problem with your address during delivery
items.text: mera address galat likha tha isliye payment agent tak nahi pahuche
mera order 9876543210 ka jo cod payment tha wo delivery guy ne accept karne se mana kar diya tha aur main paise ghar par rakha hua tha
maine delivery ke time 2000 rupees cash ready rakhe the par delivery agent ne kaha ki wo payment nahi le sakta hai toh payment cancel ho gaya
agar cod option available nahi hai toh main kaise payment karun kyunki mere paas online payment karne ka option abhi nahi hai

items.context: Why did the delivery person not take your cash payment
items.text: delivery agent ne kaha payment accept nahi kar payega kyunki wo cash lekar ghar se bahar nahi ja sakta tha

items.context: What happens if cash on delivery payment fails during delivery
items.text: agar payment stage pe problem aati hai toh kya main payment dobara kar sakta hu ya fir order cancel hoga

items.context: Can you confirm if any payment message sent to your contact number
items.text: mera contact number 98765 43210 hai jisme payment related koi notification nahi aayi jab delivery attempt hua tha

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: cod_payment - has a problem with cash on delivery or payment at the door
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
